claim.originalText: Bragg峰：带电粒子接近射程末端时单位路径能量沉积显著增加，峰后剂量快速下降；这是与光子深度剂量分布的重要区别。

conditions.isotopeGap: Exact isotope/charge not explicit in the extracted MAT metadata; not silently labelled12C
conditions.energyUnitSource: Official Particle Base Data File wiki: machine.data.energy in MeV/u; do not interpret the paper’s abbreviated MeV label as total ion energy

geometry.beam: generic pencil-beam model, laterally integrated IDD
geometry.remaining: 3mm filter from2017 generic-data methods; exact scorer geometry, lateral scoring aperture, histories and FLUKA version not recorded in this MAT file

conditions.normalization: per primary in documented base-data convention; retained native Z, no peak renormalization or Gy/RBE conversion

numerical.interpretation: Simulation describes carbon and fragments, but this Z array has no species-resolved split. Do not assign every distal value solely to a particular fragment or universal tail percentage.

references.title: Development of the open-source dose calculation and optimization toolkit matRad
references.read: Title and2.A(c), printed2558/PDF3; water, FLUKA, generic beam with3mm ripple filter; physical/biological separation

references.title: Dose influence matrix calculation
references.read: Particles/Base data; native Z units and idealized beamline; wiki is method documentation, not pinned simulation run log

priorV14.classification: approximate graph-derived estimates only; not used as input to this numeric array

remaining: Exact isotope/charge and original FLUKA scoring configuration require author/run-log confirmation
Dataset is a simulated library kernel, not a clinical beam measurement or complete raw event file
135 numeric points are traceable; professional accuracy and physical-model validity not independently approved
No matched comparison to v14: energy290.82vs290, filter/geometry and IDD vs plotted relative dose differ
minimumRevision: Distinguish specific carbon-ion physical depth-dose features and a nonzero distal region; do not generalize this kernel to all particles, energies, central-axis doses or clinical plans.
